description: Reject a requested spline order larger than the number of extended interpolation sites.

expected_error.description: Two original events plus 20 virtual events provide 22 interpolation sites, so order 23 is outside the canonical mathematical range.

oracle.description: The canonical bound is spline_order <= length(tn) + 20. MATLAB aptknt silently caps an excessive requested order, but conformant implementations must reject it so the public parameter retains its stated meaning.
